{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern U.S. cuisine]]

Crispy on the outside, coated in a sweet maple glaze.

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]], [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienned]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dark [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Cover potatoes with water. Bring to a rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and cook until tender.
#Drain thoroughly and cold shock in a bowl of iced water. Drain again.
#Combine syrup and vanilla; set aside.
#Heat oil to 375°F and [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep fry]] potatoes in batches until golden brown and crispy. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle on potatoes once all fried.
#Warm syrup mixture in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over low heat; toss with potatoes and serve.
